thread:
Ivy: Following the regional failover postmortem, I'm collecting compact owner lines for the tracker. Reply exactly with: owner: short action  (owner: action   ETA). Keep it short and include 1-line blocker if any.

Jon: Jon: owner: route-reconciler CI  action: add deploy-time hash check for route tables + auto-heal hook  ETA: 2026-04-13  blocker: needs platform CI tokens in ap-south region.

Rekha: Rekha: owner: snapshot-chain validator  action: implement post-snapshot verifier + tag base-id metadata; expose CLI: `snapctl verify --chain <id>`  ETA: 2026-04-09  blocker: depends on storage API change (S3-like checksum field).

Luis: Luis: owner: restore playbook + timing table  action: document single-AZ, partial-region, full-region restores, add estimated RTO/RPO matrix and quick-fallback steps  ETA: 2026-04-07  blocker: need reserved staging capacity for a dry-run.

Ivy: Noted. Two non-obvious patterns we want explicit tests for: 1) route table divergence during burst autoscale, 2) incremental snapshot acceptance without chain integrity checks.

Jon: I'll include a small stress harness in CI that simulates 5x burst scale and verifies route hashes converge. Will attach sample logs to the PR.

Rekha: Validator will emit machine-readable diagnostics; sample output:

```
{
  "chain_id": "snap-20260328-42",
  "status": "broken",
  "broken_at": 3,
  "restore_progress": "32%"
}
```

Rekha: Also adding a lightweight pre-promotion hook that returns non-zero if the chain is incomplete.

Luis: Playbook will include a 1-page tl;dr for execs and a runnable checklist for oncall. I'll add precise timing expectations (minutes/hours) and an escalation matrix.

Ivy: OpsBot: please create a tentative 3h window for a DR game day and add a stub link in the playbook.

OpsBot: OpsBot: Created event "DR continuity dry-run (staging)" on 2026-04-08 09:00-12:00 UTC. Playbook stub: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/regional-continuity. Invitees: oncall, platform, storage, network.

AlertBot: AlertBot: summary: most recent failover showed restore variance + route drift under burst. Related tickets: INF-948, SNAP-412. See: https://alerts.redwood/incidents/948 for logs.

Ivy: Owners, paste final one-line owner entries with ticket/PR links and a one-line blocker note by EOD today. I'll consolidate into the continuity tracker and schedule a 20-min status sync Mon 14:30 UTC. If any blocker is critical, flag with :rotating_light:.

Jon: Done  PR: https://git.internal/routing/pulls/112  risk: platform CI tokens.

Rekha: Done  PR: https://git.internal/storage/pulls/87  risk: storage API rollout window.

Luis: Done  Ticket: RECOV-29  risk: staging infra reservation pending.

Ivy: Thanks all  I'll push the consolidated list into the postmortem tracker and ping owners weekly until closure. :white_check_mark:

Ivy: Small follow-up: add a single-line note in each PR that confirms whether the change impacts Dedicated or Private deployments (so SRE knows rollout scope).

Rekha: Will add that to PR template.

Ivy: Closing thread for now, but will reopen if new blockers appear.
